title: The Discount a Circle Membership Gives on a ShieldCare Period Taken Ahead
content:
A period taken ahead of the arrears on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is priced at the plan's
monthly premium less the discount allowed on it. That discount comes from the Northbeam Circle Membership recorded on the profile, and is allowed only on a plan that applies the membership
discount.

| What the records show | The discount allowed on a period taken ahead |
| --- | --- |
| the plan applies the membership discount, the Circle membership on the profile stands active, and its tier carries a protection plan discount of more than nothing | the protection plan discount of that membership tier |
| the plan applies the membership discount, that membership stands in grace, and its tier carries a protection plan discount of more than nothing | half that discount, taken to two places |
| every other plan | no discount is allowed on a period taken ahead |

### Both sides of each condition

All three limbs of a row must hold together. A plan that does not apply the membership discount
allows none, however rich the tier. A membership whose tier carries a protection plan discount of
nothing at all allows none, whether it stands active or in grace. A membership standing lapsed or
cancelled is neither active nor in grace, so it too allows none.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

On a plan applying the membership discount whose monthly premium is 14.99, with an active membership
whose tier carries a protection plan discount of 10 percent, the discount allowed on a period taken
ahead is 10 percent and the period is priced at 13.49, taken to the cent. Were the same membership
standing in grace, the discount allowed would be half of 10 percent, that is 5 percent, and the
period would be priced at 14.24.
